correctness.rationale: Zak Parseval gives an exact half-density multiplier; the parity Wronskian is a positive constant times a single-zero Gaussian theta function, so the unperturbed multiplier has one nondegenerate zero. Its real and imaginary first derivatives are independent and yield the exact quadratic minimum after two real projections; analytic Gaussian tails rigorously separate the width-1 and width-pi coefficients. Direct checker passed 98 deterministic tests. This proof is analytic for all positive widths and all small complex admixtures, not an extrapolation from finite tests.
